_comment: Each agent defines how the harness invokes it. {prompt} is replaced with the task prompt text; {prompt_file} with a path to a file containing it. If prompt_via is 'stdin', the prompt is piped to the process instead of substituted into argv (avoids Windows arg truncation). The agent runs with its working directory set to a fresh copy of the task's workspace/.
